## Learnability vs alignment WITHIN the champion class

CAVEAT, load-bearing: this correlation is computed over the CHAMPION CLASS ONLY (the `labels scored` column), not the full 1,081-member grid. It is NOT comparable to the v2 full-grid number (-0.010 / +0.075 / -0.029) — a restricted, economically-selected slice of the grid has no reason to reproduce a grid-wide independence statistic.
